title: Backups and migration
description: Export site data and media, or import a backup into a fresh FastImg installation. Secrets are never included.
createDescription: Generate a private migration archive and download it when ready.
restoreDescription: Upload and validate a backup first. Restore is limited to a clean new site.
newServerOnly: The restore imports the database and media, and requires APP_KEY, database, Redis, email, payment, and storage credentials to be entered again. The target must have no media and at most the initial administrator.
deleteConfirm: Delete this backup file? This cannot be undone.
secretNotice: Backups exclude APP_KEY, JWT, database/Redis, email, payment, Turnstile, and object-storage secrets. Re-enter them on the target site.
restoreConfirm: This changes the new site's database and media. Continue?
unknownError: The operation failed. Try again later.
